nodes.scope:
Create tests/install-bash-native.py as a proposed fixture adapter, preserving the existing Linux runner and source guards. Proposed CLI: python3 tests/install-bash-native.py --source install.sh --bash /bin/bash --platform mac --suite detector|terminal|staging|entry|all --out <evidence-dir>. The fixture must read the exact install.sh bytes; use the supplied shell path for both outer process and inner piped Bash; check that the unmodified product itself chooses Darwin; and run set -Eeuo pipefail without disabling nounset. Load helper-only source by the existing unique top-level banner delimiter, never by stale line ranges. A complete-entry case executes the full unchanged source and reports a separate bootstrap-ready nonce emitted by BASH_ENV before installer top level.

Use private HOME/TMPDIR roots on the native volume; macOS discovery paths are HOME/Library/Application Support/Google/Chrome, Microsoft Edge, BraveSoftware/Brave-Browser and Firefox/Profiles. Contain browser executable discovery without touching /Applications: BASH_ENV may intercept only declared browser command-v/-x discovery metadata, mapping them to disposable fixture executables; all other test/id/stat/mktemp/find operations remain native. This seam is declared in the receipt and does not substitute operating-system, owner or filesystem behavior. Retain the existing guarded wrapper design for mkdir/mktemp/rm/cp/mv, local fixture-only curl/release metadata/preset transport, and intercept macOS open/pbcopy before any top-level effect. Reject any attempted path outside the fixture, real network, real clipboard or actual browser launch. Harness logs and preparation are outside the subject snapshot; no real profile/extension/storage write occurs. Capture complete stdout/stderr/exit/PTY input transcript, effect argv with original bytes, pre/post subject snapshots and artifact consumer readback. Use a fresh shell/subject per case. A bootstrap failure is an invalid fixture, not a product RED. Timeout initially retains the existing 20-second entry limit as a harness containment choice, not a performance acceptance threshold; preserve output and distinguish timeout from a native contract failure.
